notes.title: UI Refresh — A New Look for Alphabet!
notes.notes:
We’ve given the game’s interface a complete makeover to make it cleaner, more modern, and easier to navigate!

🔹 New button styles and menu elements
🔹 Improved colors, fonts, and layout
🔹 Better readability and screen adaptability

This is just the first step in improving the overall visual style of the game — more updates coming soon!
